snippet.title: Goodbye Page Steam Announcement - WISHLIST NOW!
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on steam! - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4531610/Goodbye_Page/

Goodbye Page is getting a huge update! Alongside this we are launching it on steam! We will be adding quality of life improvements, better performance, new interactions within existing levels, and new areas. We want it to feel like a complete game and reflect the heart that my co-developer and I have put into it, along with the passion your reviews have given us. Page will see you again very soon.
